notes.title: Notice - There some bugs in unreasonable places in the game
notes.content:
I am sorry about the most recent bug and realize that this is unreasonable for a game.
This was my first time developing a game, and I had a lack of relevant experience in testing the game.
I felt that everything was normal, and that the player could understand everything. But I did not think of when the game would reach players.
After that, for the first time I'm in contact with the game's players, and there are some difficult to understand problems.

I will try my best to fix these problems, and make the game more stable and more fun. 
There is something  in the source code, I have no way of fixing it right now as it is at my home and I am away for now.
I will be back home in about ten days, then I will be able to repair the bugs.
I Hope you understand, and I'm here again to express my apologies.

notes.title: 通知 - 关于游戏中的一些bug及不合理的地方
notes.content:
关于最近游戏出现的一些bug和不合理之处，我在此深表歉意。
由于我是第一次开发游戏，缺少相关的游戏测试经验。我自己测试时，觉得一切都很正常都能理解。但没有想到的是，当游戏到达玩家手上之后，对于第一次接触这个游戏的人而言，出现了一些难以理解的问题。
我会尽力修复这些问题，使游戏更稳定更好玩。但是抱歉的是，我最近因为家里有点事，身在老家，游戏及源代码等都不在我身边，我没办法及时修复。我大概十天之后会回到家中，到家之后一定第一时间修复问题。如果您不是很急的话，可以等到十多天之后再玩这款游戏。
望大家理解，在这里再次表达我的歉意。
